## C1 — paired dist_uni diff (witness − uniform) vs s

| s | seed 42 | seed 1042 | pooled | n pooled pairs |

| 0.05 | +0.2201 ±0.3012 | -0.1204 ±0.2118 | **+0.0499 ±0.1834** | 80 |
| 0.1 | +0.1928 ±0.2709 | -0.1574 ±0.2736 | **+0.0177 ±0.1916** | 80 |
| 0.25 | -0.0731* ±0.0661 | -0.0199 ±0.0676 | **-0.0465* ±0.0465** | 80 |
| 0.5 | -0.0744* ±0.0731 | -0.1127* ±0.0705 | **-0.0935* ±0.0497** | 80 |
| 1 | -0.0383 ±0.0415 | -0.0540* ±0.0500 | **-0.0461* ±0.0317** | 80 |

`*` = 95% CI excludes 0. C1 predicts the pooled column grows more negative as s shrinks.
